note: *não recebeu em vão a sua alma … receberá*: one verb for the Latin's repeated one; the blind reader found it obscure, as the Latin is. Douay-Rheims' *tomou* gives the catechism's *tomar em vão* but loses the repetition.
*de Deus, seu Salvador*: *salutári* read as a title (the Greek σωτήρ; both Vulgate-family versions), not D6's *salvação*. Cost: 24:5 *salvátor* also becomes *Salvador*. *sua salvação* is the option.

First of 16 lines of *Dóminus virtútum*: *o Senhor dos poderes*. *dos exércitos* is the familiar option (the Hebrew's Sabaoth), *das virtudes* Matos Soares 1932's. HANDOFF: wants your ruling before it spreads.
